Spectrogram settings

Display

Colour and contrast

These controls change the displayed brightness and contrast, not the sound.

Formants

Tracks are estimates; gaps indicate missing or rejected measurements.

Advanced analysis

The frequency ceiling cannot exceed half the analysis sample rate. Resampling applies only when the analysis and input rates differ; quality applies to the Kaiser polyphase filter.

Advanced colour

Peak memory, peak decay and normalization timing apply to relative held-peak colour levels.

Pitch settings

Display

Pitch estimates can be uncertain; short gaps may be connected.

Trace

Advanced trace

Long gap connections bridge missing measurements; the line between them is not a measurement.

Practice target

Edit the frequency limits to suit your practice.

Offline use

Offline downloads are available in the built app.

Developer settings

Performance diagnostics

Enable before starting a test. Run for several minutes, then export the report. No audio is included or uploaded. Reset after changing settings.
